title: Start action on embedded symbols
statement: For every alphabet $\Gamma$, state type $S$, number $k$ of work tapes, state $q\in S$, and possibly absent symbol $x\in\operatorname{Option}(\Gamma)$, the guarded start action on the image of $x$ under the alphabet embedding equals the initialization action toward $q$.
hypotheses_covered: arbitrary state type S and q ∈ S
replaced:
For every base state $q$ and every possibly absent base symbol, the guarded start
action evaluated at the image of that symbol under the alphabet embedding equals
the plain initialization action toward $q$: embedded symbols never trigger the
halting guard.
